benchmark_metadata.title: Boundary Multi-Forum Dispute (Commercial B2B, NI Act 138 Cheque Bounce & Criminal Threat)

scope_guardrail.escalation_advice: Dishonour of cheques and debt recovery under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 are quasi-criminal proceedings falling outside the jurisdiction of Consumer Commissions. You must issue a formal Statutory Demand Notice within 30 days of receiving the cheque return memo, demanding payment within 15 days. If payment is not received, a criminal complaint must be filed before the competent Judicial Magistrate / Metropolitan Magistrate within one month. You are advised to immediately engage an Advocate enrolled with the Bar Council of India to draft the statutory notice and represent you.
